skill_index.comment: Upgrade 2: Skill Index Pre-Binding. Store in persistent memory Layer 5 (Operational Rules). DO NOT include skill definitions here — only trigger keywords, invocation instructions, and credential source pointers.

gmail_automation.short_description: Read/write Gmail, parse unread, filter action items, send messages
gmail_automation.instruction: Auto-use gmail-automation for Gmail tasks: retrieve email list, parse unread, filter for action items, send if requested

github_ops_skill.short_description: GitHub operations: branches, commits, PRs, repo management
github_ops_skill.instruction: Auto-use github-ops-skill for GitHub tasks: handle authentication, branch management, PR operations, commit workflows

fitness_intelligence_api.short_description: Fitness program routing: stage progression, exercise pairing, routine assignment
fitness_intelligence_api.instruction: Auto-use fitness-intelligence-api: load stage state from Google Sheets, validate muscle pairings (approved/forbidden), route to appropriate API endpoint

google_calendar_sync.short_description: Google Calendar operations: read/write events, manage availability
google_calendar_sync.instruction: Auto-use google-calendar-sync for calendar tasks: read existing events, create/modify/delete as requested, manage blocking/availability

instagram_automation.short_description: Instagram profile analysis: handle lookup, follower metrics, post insights
instagram_automation.instruction: Auto-use instagram-automation: validate session, query Instagram API, parse profile data, return metrics/analysis
instagram_automation.credential_source: EDITH.credentials.instagram (session-based; may require re-auth if stale)
instagram_automation.note: Session-based auth; check EDITH for expiry before invocation

auto_binding_rules.comment: Upgrade 5: Proactive Skill Auto-Binding. When user message contains keyword, agent detects it, looks up skill_index, loads instruction + credential, invokes skill directly.

instagram_task.note: Confirm session is fresh before invoking

cost_before_binding.description: Without pre-binding, each task requires: skill lookup + credential injection + skill invocation

cost_after_binding.description: With pre-binding, keyword match triggers cached instruction + credential routing

savings.note: Actual savings will be 50-60% of this estimate (some tasks fail to bind, false positives require confirmation)

on_deployment: Confirm all 5 skills are in skill library (skill_view works for each)
Confirm skill_index loads from persistent memory (no missing entries)
Confirm trigger keywords are spelled correctly (typos break auto-binding)
Test auto-binding with 10 sample user messages; confirm 9/10 detect correctly
Monitor false positive rate (unintended skill triggers); adjust confidence_threshold if > 10%
ongoing_monitoring: Weekly: check that skill definitions haven't changed (if changed, update index)
Monthly: measure auto-binding success rate (should be > 85%)
Monthly: measure token savings (auto-binding should save ~80% of per-task cost)
Quarterly: review trigger keywords (add new ones, remove dead keywords)
